sn7.15:1.2: _Mānatthaddha_, literally “stiff with pride”. So stiff, apparently, he could not bow. Also used of a brahmin at [dn4:8.17]().
sn7.15:6.3: nihacca, though given in the dicts as “destroy, strike down”, is only used in contexts of conceit, or “bending the knee” to bow. It thus seems to have a more specific nuance.
